label: Everyday Life & Leisure
scope_note: The ordinary practices of living: food, clothing, home, the passages of a life, play, sport, travel and celebration.

label: Food and drink
scope_note: What people eat and drink, how they prepare it, and what it means to them.

label: Cooking
scope_note: Techniques of preparing food.

label: Cuisines of the world
scope_note: The cooking traditions of the world's regions and communities.

label: Beverages
scope_note: Water, tea, coffee, fermented and distilled drinks, and the customs around them.

label: Food customs and dietary laws
scope_note: Rules and customs about what, when and with whom to eat, including religious dietary laws and vegetarian traditions.

label: Clothing and adornment
scope_note: Clothing, and the ways people adorn and modify their bodies.

label: Traditional dress
scope_note: Customary clothing of communities and regions.

label: Jewellery, cosmetics and body modification
scope_note: Jewellery, cosmetics, hairstyles, tattooing and other body modification.

label: Home and household
scope_note: Dwellings, the work of running a household, and domestic life.

label: Housing
scope_note: Kinds of dwelling and how people obtain and share them.

label: Household and care work
scope_note: Cooking, cleaning, caring for children and relatives, and other household work, much of it unpaid.

label: Gardening
scope_note: Growing plants for food, beauty and pleasure.

label: Pets and companion animals
scope_note: Animals kept for companionship.

label: Rites of passage and life events
scope_note: The customs that mark birth, growing up, partnership and death.

label: Birth and naming customs
scope_note: Customs surrounding pregnancy, birth and the naming of children.

label: Coming of age
scope_note: Rites and customs marking the passage to adulthood.

label: Marriage and partnership
scope_note: Forms of marriage and partnership and their ceremonies.

label: Funerals and mourning
scope_note: Practices surrounding death: funerals, burial, cremation, mourning and remembrance.

label: Festivals, holidays and celebrations
scope_note: Religious and secular festivals, holidays and celebrations.

label: Calendars and timekeeping
scope_note: Calendar systems — solar, lunar and lunisolar, such as the Gregorian, Islamic, Hebrew, Chinese, Hindu and Maya calendars — and the measurement of time.

label: Sport
scope_note: Competitive physical games and physical activity.

label: Ball sports
scope_note: Games played with a ball, such as association football, cricket, basketball, volleyball and hockey.

label: Athletics
scope_note: Running, jumping, throwing and walking events.

label: Martial arts and combat sports
scope_note: Fighting arts and combat sports, such as wrestling, boxing, judo, karate, taekwondo, capoeira and kung fu.

label: Water sports
scope_note: Swimming, diving, rowing, sailing, surfing and other sports on or in water.

label: Winter sports
scope_note: Skiing, skating and other sports on snow and ice.

label: Equestrian and animal sports
scope_note: Sports with horses and other animals.

label: Traditional sports and games
scope_note: Sports rooted in particular communities, such as buzkashi, kabaddi, sepak takraw, hurling and oil wrestling.

label: Physical fitness and exercise
scope_note: Exercise and fitness for health and enjoyment.

label: Games and play
scope_note: Play and games of every kind.

label: Board and table games
scope_note: Board, card, dice and tile games, such as chess, go, mancala, backgammon, mahjong and dominoes.

label: Video games
scope_note: Games played on electronic devices.

label: Children's play and toys
scope_note: Play, games and toys of childhood.

label: Games of chance and gambling
scope_note: Games decided wholly or partly by chance, and betting on outcomes.

label: Hobbies and recreation
scope_note: Pastimes people pursue for enjoyment.

label: Outdoor recreation
scope_note: Walking, climbing, camping, recreational fishing and other time spent outdoors.

label: Travel and tourism
scope_note: Travel for leisure and the hospitality that serves it.

label: Etiquette and social customs
scope_note: Manners, greetings, gift-giving, hospitality and other customs of everyday interaction.
